Testing detectCharsetFromBom via parseInputStream: Provide InputStream starting with UTF-8 BOM, ensure DataUtil parses with charset UTF-8 (maybe we can check that charset used is set in Document outputSettings). Provide UTF-16 BOM etc.

Testing parseInputStream behavior: when charsetName null and meta charset present; when charsetName provided and valid; when charsetName invalid (maybe Validate.notEmpty will throw IllegalArgumentException). Provide HTML with meta charset and verify detection.

Testing load(File) and load(InputStream) methods use parseInputStream.

Edge cases: null InputStream (should return empty Document with baseUri). Provide null input to parseInputStream via reflection? Actually parseInputStream is package-private static; we can call DataUtil.parseInputStream directly because it's in same package org.jsoup.helper. Our test class should be in same package to access package-private methods. So we can put test class in org.jsoup.helper.

Test for empty input stream: new ByteArrayInputStream(new byte[0]) -> parseInputStream returns Document with baseUri.

Test error scenario: readToByteBuffer with negative maxSize throws IllegalArgumentException.

Test readFileToByteBuffer when file not found? The method expects existing file; we can test that FileNotFoundException is thrown.

3. testReadToByteBufferWithMaxSize: Provide larger data, limit size, ensure buffer limit size.

5. testReadFileToByteBuffer: create temp file with bytes, call method, compare.

13. testParseInputStreamDetectMetaCharset: InputStream with HTML containing <meta charset="ISO-8859-1">, charsetName null, ensure document outputSettings charset is ISO-8859-1.

14. testParseInputStreamSpecifiedCharset: InputStream with charsetName "UTF-8", ensure outputSettings charset set.

15. testParseInputStreamNullInput: input null, baseUri "http://example.com", expect Document with baseUri.

16. testLoadFileMethod: create temp file with html, call DataUtil.load(file, null, baseUri), assert Document.
